text:
You are a retrospective reviewer. Given RECENT ACTIVITY and a list of OPEN BETS, OLD DECISIONS, and OPEN EXPERIMENTS for a project, judge each item:

  resolved     — clear evidence the bet paid off / experiment concluded / decision validated
  still_open   — not enough evidence to judge yet
  contradicted — recent actions directly contradict a decision or invalidate a bet
  stale        — no new relevant evidence in > 60 days

Rules:
  - Be conservative: prefer 'still_open' over premature resolution.
  - confidence_delta: only set for bets; range -0.5 to +0.5; 0.0 if not resolved/contradicted.
  - target_id: the exact id string shown in brackets (e.g. '3').
  - Include all items; emit 'still_open' for anything you cannot judge.
  - stale_bet_ids / contradicted_decision_ids: populate from verdicts for convenience.
  - narrative: 2-3 sentence plain-language summary of the key findings.

IMPORTANT OUTPUT FORMAT RULES — follow exactly:
- Respond with ONLY a valid JSON object.
- Start your response with { and end with }
- No prose, no explanation, no markdown, no code fences.
- Every field in the schema is required unless marked optional.

JSON Schema (OutcomeReport)
Fields:
  verdicts (optional): array of object(target_id: string, target_type: one of: "bet", "decision", "experiment", verdict: one of: "resolved", "still_open", "contradicted", "stale", reasoning: string, confidence_delta: number, checked_at: string)
  stale_bet_ids (optional): array of string
  contradicted_decision_ids (optional): array of string
  synthesis_ready_experiment_ids (optional): array of string
  narrative (optional): string

# Handoff — 2026-05-31_1732

Built planchadito (apps/planchadito) — family meal planning Habitat app. Stage 5 (self-improving). Full agentic system: planner.py LLM tool loop, 5-step contract, Postgres state layer (db.py), Telegram bot (all commands), FastAPI web UI, APScheduler weekly trigger, Dockerfile + Railway config. 13 vault cards seeded (Harvard Plate principles P001-P006, family constraints C001-C005, breastfeeding P001, vision/decision). Deployment requires: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS, DATABASE_URL (Railway provides). Next: Adrian gets bot token + chat IDs, deploys to Railway.

Recent issue updates: Package beast-mode setup as Raising Agents content (done), Lab agents: interactive AI personas embedded in the site, each expert in one RA  (done), Build interactive lab agents — visitors talk to behavioral agents on the site (done), Workbench artifacts registry — transparent "The Stack" page listing all built ar (done), Close beast-mode content issue — workbench post and repo already shipped (done)

OPEN BETS (5):
  [1] Publishing Paper 1 + open-sourcing abw will drive 5%+ of active subscribers to integrate behavior contracts into their eval pipeline by end-2026 | confidence: 0.55 | logged: 2026-05-27
      evidence needed: abw GitHub stars, install counts, reader survey asking 'do you run behavior contracts', inbound from engineers citing abw in their own code
  [2] Behavior Watch (bi-weekly, artifact-per-issue) is the right distribution format for reaching engineers who already have evals but lack behavioral regression tooling | confidence: 0.65 | logged: 2026-05-27
      evidence needed: Open rate after first 5 issues (target >40%). Reply/feedback signals on trace teardowns vs narrative issues. Unsubscribe rate. Compare cohort from paper launch vs organic watch subscribers — do they stick differently?
  [3] Research-first sequencing (papers → credibility → audience) outperforms content-first for this project's 3-year horizon | confidence: 0.75 | logged: 2026-05-27
      evidence needed: Subscriber quality indicators — what % are engineers actually building agents (vs passive AI consumers). Inbound quality post paper submissions. Compare peer newsletters that went content-first.
  [4] The press (automated editorial pipeline) enables sustainable weekly output without creator burnout | confidence: 0.6 | logged: 2026-05-27
      evidence needed: 8 consecutive weeks of press running without manual intervention. Measure: does episode shipping frequency hold while paper work is also active? Does Adrian log relief or friction?
  [5] Paper 3 (mined contracts via process mining) closes the recall ceiling from Paper 1 and is the highest-leverage next research contribution | confidence: 0.8 | logged: 2026-05-27
      evidence needed: Inductive Miner on OPBR-Bench corpus yields recall > 0.214 on held-out semi-blind conditions. If F1 matches Study 5 (0.982) with zero specification labor, the bet validates.

DECISIONS >30d OLD (6):
  [1] No iPhone/wearable data — use pmset Mac-dark as sleep proxy, labelled 'Mac dark' not 'slept' | logged: 2026-04-24
  [2] Staging publish model: indicator auto-commits + deploys; log line stages for Adrian to push; episodes stage to beehiiv for Adrian to publish | logged: 2026-04-24
  [3] Separate private repo (raising-agents-press) for the press — raw daily activity is personal ops data, never touches public site repo | logged: 2026-04-24
  [4] The press is not publishable content until episode 010 — hard rule | logged: 2026-04-24
  [5] Workspace as symlinks: ~/raising-agents/ is a single entry point, all subdirs are symlinks to real homes (two git repos, two Obsidian vaults, hidden runtime) | logged: 2026-04-20
  [6] Paper 1 ships before aggressive audience building — research credibility first | logged: 2026-05-01

OPEN EXPERIMENTS (5):
  [1] If we publish Paper 1 + release abw publicly, we will see measurable adoption (installs, GitHub stars, reader survey responses citing behavior contracts) within 60 days | findings: 0
  [2] If first 5 Behavior Watch issues maintain >40% open rate and artifact-focused issues outperform narrative ones on click-through, the format (bi-weekly + one artifact) is validated for target audience | findings: 0
  [3] Inductive Miner on OPBR-Bench 755-trace corpus yields recall > 0.214 on held-out semi-blind perturbation conditions | findings: 0
  [4] If press runs uninterrupted for 8 consecutive weeks with no manual intervention, then weekly episode output frequency holds while Paper 3 work is simultaneously active | findings: 0
  [5] If subscriber quality (% engineers actually building agents) after Paper 1 launch is >60% of subscriber base, research-first sequencing attracted the right audience | findings: 0
